Article 31C was inserted by which Amendment Act?
faqs.e: Article 31C saves laws implementing the socialistic directive principles specified in Article 39(b) and (c) from being void on grounds of contravening Articles 14 or 19.

faqs.q: In the Kesavananda Bharati case, the Supreme Court declared which provision of Article 31C unconstitutional?

options.a: The provision saving laws implementing Article 39
options.c: The provision barring judicial review of the declaration that a law gives effect to such policy

faqs.a: The provision barring judicial review of the declaration that a law gives effect to such policy
faqs.e: This was held unconstitutional on the ground that judicial review is a basic feature; the provision saving such laws from Article 14/19 challenge was upheld as constitutional and valid.

faqs.q: The 42nd Amendment's extension of Article 31C's protection to all Directive Principles was declared unconstitutional in which case?

Consider the following criticisms of the Fundamental Rights:
(I) They are stated in a vague, indefinite and ambiguous manner
(II) They make no provision for social and economic rights like right to work
(III) They are permanent and cannot be curtailed even by constitutional amendment
Which of the above is/are correct?
faqs.e: Fundamental Rights are not permanent or sacrosanct — Parliament can curtail or abolish them by constitutional amendment, as with the abolition of the right to property in 1978; the only limitation is the judicially innovated doctrine of basic structure.
